name: autonear
description: AutoNEAR protocol: evidence-to-product operating system for NEAR

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run contract:evm:test && npm run contract:near:test && npm run contract:near-vault:test && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.d1:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply autonear --local
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run web:build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.contract:test: npm run contract:near:test && npm run contract:near-vault:test && npm run contract:evm:test
scripts.contract:near-vault:test: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" sh -c "cd contracts/near-vault && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked"
scripts.contract:near-vault:integration: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" sh -c "bash scripts/near-build.sh >/dev/null && bash scripts/near-vault-build.sh >/dev/null && cd contracts/near-vault/integration && cargo test"
scripts.test:vault: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" node --test tests/vault-model.test.js tests/vault-model-pay.test.js tests/vault-pay-conformance.test.js tests/vault-service.test.js tests/autonomy.test.js tests/vault-near.test.js tests/vault-near-pay.test.js
